chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: “How should I apply the ḥanūṭ?” He said: “You place it in his mouth, his hearing passages, and on the marks of sajdah from his face, his hands, and his knees.”

key_terms.آثَارِ السُّجُودِ: the bodily places marked or designated for prostration
key_terms.الْحَنُوطِ: camphor or funerary perfume applied to the deceased

ai.seo_question: How should ḥanūṭ be applied to the deceased according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding the application of ḥanūṭ to the deceased. It specifies the bodily locations where it is to be placed, especially the sites associated with sajdah, reflecting the ritual treatment of the dead in Shia fiqh.
